items.markdown:
UK passport holders can currently stay in Thailand for up to **60 days** without a visa under the Visa Exemption Scheme. This stay can be extended for an additional 30 days at a local Thai immigration office, bringing the maximum total to 90 days. *Note: The Thai government has announced plans to adjust visa-free lengths for various countries, so check current updates before you fly.* [](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements) [[1]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements)[[2]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/exemp-visa)[[3]](https://cibtvisas.co.uk/thailand-visa)[[4]](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c78q3qjqnn5o)

Entry Requirements

- **Passport Validity:** Must be valid for at least 6 months from your arrival date.
- **Digital Arrival Card:** Must submit the Thailand Digital Arrival Card online within 3 days before you arrive.
- **Onward Ticket:** Proof of a confirmed flight or travel ticket leaving Thailand within 60 days.
- **Funds:** Proof of money to support your stay.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=65bb7713d0737318de2bab23) [[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=65bb7713d0737318de2bab23)
